avatar.title: Profile photo
avatar.description: Shown next to your name for your teammates.
avatar.hint: Drop a photo here or choose one. PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF; it is cropped to a square.
avatar.badType: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF picture.
avatar.tooBig: That picture is too large (up to 12 MB).
avatar.unreadable: That file could not be read as a picture.

profile.title: Personal information
profile.description: Your name and details are what teammates see on tasks, comments and chat.
profile.name: Full name
profile.emailUnverifiedHint: Confirm your address to receive invitations and reminders.
profile.workDescription: Helps teammates know who you are and when to reach you.
profile.timezoneHint: Used to show your local time to teammates.
profile.bioPlaceholder: A few words about what you do and how you like to work.
profile.pronounsHint: Optional. Shown on your profile card.
profile.workHint: Teammates see when you are usually online.

signin.title: Sign-in methods
signin.description: How you can get into this account.

password.title: Change password
password.description: Choose a strong password you do not use anywhere else.
password.descriptionSet: You signed in with a provider. Add a password to also sign in with your email.
password.rules: At least 10 characters, with 3 of: lower case, upper case, digits, symbols.
password.changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
password.signsOut: Changing your password signs out every other device.

devices.title: Where you are signed in
devices.description: Sign out of any device you do not recognise.
devices.signOutOthers: Sign out of all other devices

links.title: Links
links.description: Where teammates can find you outside the platform.
links.linkedinHint: A profile address or just your handle.

about.title: Introduction
about.description: A short introduction and what you are good at.

skills.title: Skills
skills.hint: Press Enter after each one. Up to 10.

cover.hint: A wide picture works best. It is cropped to a strip.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: Ask for a code from an authenticator app when you sign in, on top of your password.
twoFactor.offHint: Protect your account even if your password leaks.
twoFactor.setupDescription: Use an app such as Google Authenticator, 1Password or Authy.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key by hand:
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.codeOrRecovery: Code from the app, or a recovery code
twoFactor.codesDescription: Keep these somewhere safe. Each works once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
twoFactor.disableDescription: Your account will only need the password. Enter a current code and your password to confirm.
twoFactor.regenerateDescription: The old codes stop working. Enter a current code to confirm.
